{{Top|leg}}
The '''First Hall of Brentioch''' was a large building on [[Brentaal IV/Legends|Brentaal IV]] during the era that [[Freia Kallea/Legends|Freia Kallea]] first blazed the [[Hydian Way/Legends|Hydian Way]]. A recreation of the edifice was part of the sets used in the [[Opera/Legends|opera]] ''[[The Kallea Cycle]]''.<ref name="GNN">{{JournalCite|13|Galaxywide NewsNets}}</ref>
